name: Detail Process Quality Control (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses ProcessQualityControlRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-100, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route/factory/model files)

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewProcessQualityControlView.vue's detail mode exactly (Process QC ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid Process Quality Control Detail with all 16 non-time_slot columns), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/process-quality-control/{id} registered after /data/process-quality-control/create (screen-120) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
UNLIKE Detail Threshing: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind

404 handled automatically by ModelNotFoundException -> ApiExceptionHandler (findOrFail) for the API controller, and via the notFound flag in DetailProcessQualityControl Livewire component, same as every other detail screen in this codebase
Detail grid table has min-width: 2200px (17 columns incl. Time-Slot) due to the 16 non-time_slot columns -- the widest detail table in the project

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DetailProcessQualityControlTest.php) exists following this codebase's established convention but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review, consistent with the codebase's Browser/* convention.
